notes: Garruk's Uprising, printed: 'Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.' The trigger is for each creature, also when several enter at the same time. Three Glorious Anthems (each: 'Creatures you control get +1/+1.') make every creature I control +3/+3; Goblin Wizardry ('Create two 1/1 red Goblin Wizard creature tokens with prowess.') puts two 1/1 tokens onto the battlefield in one go, and they enter as 4/4s: the Uprising triggers once for each of them and I draw two cards (the hand held only the instant and now holds the two drawn cards). The two triggers are both mine and wait on the stack together: their order is asked and either order gives the same result.
